frequency_question: How often do official regulatory capital buffer increase announcements successfully meet precise threshold criteria when policy action occurs?
membership_rule: Members are central bank policy decisions regarding the countercyclical capital buffer or equivalent macroprudential capital add-ons; excluded are general interest rate or liquidity facility decisions.

cases.name: Bank of England UK CCyB activation 2016
Bank of England UK CCyB increase 2018
Reserve Bank of New Zealand CCyB increase 2018
Swiss National Bank Countercyclical Buffer increase 2013

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 7 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 7 named; representative of developed market macroprudential policy framing where formal Board announcements unambiguously match written resolution thresholds.
known_gaps: Excludes minor emerging market iterations, but captures institutional standards relevant to the Federal Reserve.
skeleton: Identified major G10 and comparable central bank CCyB activation and increase announcements where regulatory intent translated directly into formal press releases.
multiplier: 7 hits out of 7 intended and executed policy tightening events meeting formal criteria
validity_reason: Central bank regulatory communication standards and formal press release mechanisms remain highly stable over multi-year horizons.
